turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Linkwave, you're speaking with Hannah Brooks. This call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Morning. This is the second time I've called this week. My internet is down again. Nothing has worked since last night, and I work from home.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry, that's really frustrating, especially when you're working from home. Before I check the line I need to confirm who I'm speaking with. Could I have your full name and account number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Daniel Whitmore. The account number is four zero, two two one, eight seven three.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Whitmore. And the first line of the address the service is installed at?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 14 Calder Road, flat 3.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, that matches. I can see a ticket from Tuesday. Was the router restarted that time?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, your colleague had me unplug it, and it came back for about a day. Now it's dead again. The light on the front is flashing red.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Flashing red means the router can't see a signal from our network, so this isn't a setting on your side. Let me run a line test now. It takes about a minute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. But honestly, I'm paying for this every month and I've lost two working days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. The test shows a fault outside your home, most likely at the street cabinet. I'm booking an engineer for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: When? I can't wait another week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The earliest slot is tomorrow between eight and twelve. Will someone be home then?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I'll be in. Can the engineer call before they arrive?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Is the best number still the mobile ending in four eight two?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Because this is the second outage this week, I'm also adding a credit for the days without service. It will show on your next bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that helps a bit. And if it goes down again after the repair?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then call us and quote ticket number seven seven three one zero, and you'll go straight to the technical team without repeating everything.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. Thanks for sorting it out.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Mr Whitmore. Is there anything else I can help with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all. Bye.
